title: Detailed aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M84 52 Q92 52 90 48 Q88 44 84 46 Z' fill='#c0392b'/>

  <path d='M42 78 L58 76 L58 82 L42 82 Z' fill='#ffcc00' opacity='0.6'/>

  <ellipse cx='48' cy='36' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#95a5a6'/>

  <circle cx='62' cy='51' r='1.8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='51' r='1.8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='51' r='1.8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='51' r='1.8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='51' r='1.8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='51' r='1.8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>

  <path d='M26 55 L78 55 L78 57 L26 57 Z' fill='#e74c3c' opacity='0.8'/>

  <path d='M78 47 L82 46 L84 48 L82 52 L78 52 Z' fill='none' stroke='#3498db' stroke-width='1'/>
